# gtm_v1_publish_container_version (Action)

Publishes a Container Version.



<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `account_id` (String) The GTM Account ID.
- `container_id` (String) The GTM Container ID.
- `container_version_id` (String) The GTM Container Version ID.

### Optional

- `fingerprint` (String) When provided, this fingerprint must match the fingerprint of the container version in storage.
